13.english_reference: and the LORD will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you .

traditions.WLC: וְ יִנָּחֵ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה אֶל הָ֣ רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר עֲלֵי כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ παύσεται Κύριος ἀπὸ τῶν κακῶν ὧν ἐλάλησεν ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς .
traditions.VUL: et pœnitébit Dóminum mali , quod locútus est advérsum vos .
traditions.KJV: and the LORD will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you .

14.english_reference: As for me , behold , I [ am ] in your hand :

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲנִ֖י הִנְ נִ֣י בְ יֶדְ כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐν χερσὶν ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Ego autem ecce in mánibus vestris sum :
traditions.KJV: As for me , behold , I [ am ] in your hand :

14.english_reference: do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you .

traditions.WLC: עֲשׂוּ לִ֛ י כַּ טּ֥וֹב וְ כַ יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ עֵינֵי כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: ποιήσατέ μοι ὡς συμφέρει καὶ ὡς βέλτιον ὑμῖν .
traditions.VUL: fácite mihi quod bonum et rectum est in óculis vestris :
traditions.KJV: do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you .

15.english_reference: But know ye for certain , that if ye put me to death ,

traditions.WLC: אַ֣ךְ יָדֹ֣עַ תֵּדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אִם מְמִתִ֣ים אַתֶּם֮ אֹתִ י֒
traditions.LXX: ἀλλ᾽ ἢ γνόντες γνώσεσθε ὅτι εἰ ἀναιρεῖτέ με ,
traditions.VUL: verúmtamen scitóte et cognóscite quod si occidéritis me ,
traditions.KJV: But know ye for certain , that if ye put me to death ,

15.english_reference: ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves , and upon this city , and upon the inhabitants thereof :

traditions.WLC: כִּי דָ֣ם נָקִ֗י אַתֶּם֙ נֹתְנִ֣ים עֲלֵי כֶ֔ם וְ אֶל הָ עִ֥יר הַ זֹּ֖את וְ אֶל יֹשְׁבֶ֑י הָ
traditions.LXX: αἷμα ἀθῷον δίδοτε ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν ταύτην καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν αὐτῇ ·
traditions.VUL: sánguinem innocéntem tradétis contra vosmetípsos , et contra civitátem istam , et habitatóres eius :
traditions.KJV: ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves , and upon this city , and upon the inhabitants thereof :

15.english_reference: for of a truth the LORD hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י בֶ אֱמֶ֗ת שְׁלָחַ֤ נִי יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵי כֶ֔ם לְ דַבֵּר֙ בְּ אָזְנֵי כֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ אֵֽלֶּה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐν ἀληθείᾳ ἀπέσταλκέν με Κύριος πρὸς ὑμᾶς λαλῆσαι εἰς τὰ ὦτα ὑμῶν πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους .
traditions.VUL: in veritáte enim misit me Dóminus ad vos , ut lóquerer in áuribus vestris ómnia verba hæc .
traditions.KJV: for of a truth the LORD hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears .

16.english_reference: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּאמְר֤וּ הַ שָּׂרִים֙ וְ כָל הָ עָ֔ם אֶל הַ כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ אֶל הַ נְּבִיאִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ ἄρχοντες καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς πρὸς τοὺς ἱερεῖς καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ψευδοπροφήτας
traditions.VUL: Et dixérunt príncipes , et omnis pópulus , ad sacerdótes , et ad prophétas :
traditions.KJV: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets ;

16.english_reference: This man [ is ] not worthy to die :

traditions.WLC: אֵין לָ אִ֤ישׁ הַ זֶּה֙ מִשְׁפַּט מָ֔וֶת
traditions.LXX: Οὐκ ἔστιν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τούτῳ κρίσις θανάτου ,
traditions.VUL: Non est viro huic iudícium mortis ,
traditions.KJV: This man [ is ] not worthy to die :

16.english_reference: for he hath spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֗י בְּ שֵׁ֛ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י נוּ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֵֽי נוּ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι Κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐλάλησεν πρὸς ἡμᾶς .
traditions.VUL: quia in nómine Dómini Dei nostri locútus est ad nos .
traditions.KJV: for he hath spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God .

17.english_reference: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּקֻ֣מוּ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים מִ זִּקְנֵ֖י הָ אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέστησαν ἄνδρες τῶν πρεσβυτέρων τῆς γῆς
traditions.VUL: Surrexérunt ergo viri de senióribus terræ ,
traditions.KJV: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land ,

17.english_reference: and spake to all the assembly of the people , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֶל כָּל קְהַ֥ל הָ עָ֖ם לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπαν πάσῃ τῇ συναγωγῇ τοῦ λαοῦ
traditions.VUL: et dixérunt ad omnem cœtum pópuli , loquéntes :
traditions.KJV: and spake to all the assembly of the people , saying ,

18.english_reference: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah ,

traditions.WLC: מיכיה הַ מּ֣וֹרַשְׁתִּ֔י הָיָ֣ה נִבָּ֔א בִּ ימֵ֖י חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Μειχαίας ὁ Μωραθείτης ἦν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἑζεκίου βασιλέως Ἰούδα
traditions.VUL: Michǽas de Morásthi fuit prophéta in diébus Ezechíæ regis Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah ,

18.english_reference: and spake to all the people of Judah ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל כָּל עַם֩ יְהוּדָ֨ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν παντὶ τῷ λαῷ Ἰούδα
traditions.VUL: et ait ad omnem pópulum Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: and spake to all the people of Judah ,

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֜ר
traditions.VUL: dicens :
traditions.KJV: saying ,

18.english_reference: Thus saith the LORD of hosts ;

traditions.WLC: כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת
traditions.LXX: Οὕτως εἶπεν Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus exercítuum :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD of hosts ;

18.english_reference: Zion shall be plowed [ like ] a field ,

traditions.WLC: צִיּ֞וֹן שָׂדֶ֤ה תֵֽחָרֵשׁ֙
traditions.LXX: Σειὼν ὡς ἀγρὸς ἀροτριαθήσεται ,
traditions.VUL: Sion quasi ager arábitur ,
traditions.KJV: Zion shall be plowed [ like ] a field ,

traditions.WLC: וִ ירוּשָׁלַ֨יִם֙ עִיִּ֣ים תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἰερουσαλὴμ εἰς ἄβατον ἔσται ,
traditions.VUL: et Ierúsalem in acérvum lápidum erit ,
traditions.KJV: and Jerusalem shall become heaps ,

18.english_reference: and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest .

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ֥ר הַ בַּ֖יִת לְ בָמ֥וֹת יָֽעַר
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ ὄρος τοῦ οἴκου εἰς ἄλσος δρυμοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et mons domus in excélsa silvárum .
traditions.KJV: and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest .

19.english_reference: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death ?

traditions.WLC: הֶ הָמֵ֣ת הֱ֠מִתֻ הוּ חִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֜ה וְ כָל יְהוּדָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: μὴ ἀνελὼν ἀνεῖλεν αὐτὸν Ἑζεκίας καὶ πᾶς Ἰουδά ;
traditions.VUL: Numquid morte condemnávit eum Ezechías rex Iuda , et omnis Iuda ?
traditions.KJV: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death ?

19.english_reference: did he not fear the LORD , and besought the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: הֲ לֹא֮ יָרֵ֣א אֶת יְהוָה֒ וַ יְחַל֙ אֶת פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: οὐχ ὅτι ἐφοβήθησαν τὸν κύριον , καὶ ὅτι ἐδεήθησαν τοῦ προσώπου Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: numquid non timuérunt Dóminum , et deprecáti sunt fáciem Dómini :
traditions.KJV: did he not fear the LORD , and besought the LORD ,

19.english_reference: and the LORD repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them ?

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּנָּ֣חֶם יְהוָ֔ה אֶל הָ רָעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֣ר עֲלֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπαύσατο Κύριος ἀπὸ τῶν κακῶν ὧν ἐλάλησεν ἐπ᾽ αὐτούς ;
traditions.VUL: et pœnítuit Dóminum mali , quod locútus fúerat advérsum eos ?
traditions.KJV: and the LORD repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them ?

19.english_reference: Thus might we procure great evil against our souls .

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲנַ֗חְנוּ עֹשִׂ֛ים רָעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה עַל נַפְשׁוֹתֵֽי נוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐποιήσαμεν κακὰ μεγάλα ἐπὶ ψυχὰς ἡμῶν .
traditions.VUL: Itaque nos fácimus malum grande contra ánimas nostras .
traditions.KJV: Thus might we procure great evil against our souls .

20.english_reference: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the LORD , Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjathjearim ,

traditions.WLC: וְ גַם אִ֗ישׁ הָיָ֤ה מִתְנַבֵּא֙ בְּ שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה אֽוּרִיָּ֨הוּ֙ בֶּֽן שְׁמַעְיָ֔הוּ מִ קִּרְיַ֖ת הַיְּעָרִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἄνθρωπος ἦν προφητεύων τῷ ὀνόματι Κυρίου , Οὐρείας υἱὸς Σαμαίου ἐκ Καριαθιαρείμ ,
traditions.VUL: Fuit quoque vir prophétans in nómine Dómini , Urías fílius Sémei de Cariathíarim ,
traditions.KJV: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the LORD , Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjathjearim ,

20.english_reference: who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah :

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּנָּבֵ֞א עַל הָ עִ֤יר הַ זֹּאת֙ וְ עַל הָ אָ֣רֶץ הַ זֹּ֔את כְּ כֹ֖ל דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָֽהוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπροφήτευσεν περὶ τῆς γῆς ταύτης κατὰ πάντας τοὺς λόγους Ἰερεμίου .
traditions.VUL: et prophetávit advérsus civitátem istam , et advérsus terram hanc , iuxta ómnia verba Ieremíæ .
traditions.KJV: who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah :

21.english_reference: And when Jehoiakim the king , with all his mighty men , and all the princes , heard his words

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַ מֶּֽלֶךְ יְ֠הוֹיָקִים וְ כָל גִּבּוֹרָ֤י ו וְ כָל הַ שָּׂרִים֙ אֶת דְּבָרָ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤκουσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἰωακεὶμ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες πάντας τοὺς λόγους αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Et audívit rex Ióakim , et omnes poténtes , et príncipes eius verba hæc :
traditions.KJV: And when Jehoiakim the king , with all his mighty men , and all the princes , heard his words ,

21.english_reference: the king sought to put him to death

traditions.WLC: ו וַ יְבַקֵּ֥שׁ הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ הֲמִית֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐζήτουν ἀποκτεῖναι αὐτόν ·
traditions.VUL: et quæsívit rex interfícere eum .
traditions.KJV: the king sought to put him to death :

21.english_reference: but when Urijah heard it , he was afraid

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁמַ֤ע אוּרִיָּ֨הוּ֙ וַ יִּרָ֔א
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤκουσεν Οὐρείας ,
traditions.VUL: Et audívit Urías , et tímuit ,
traditions.KJV: but when Urijah heard it , he was afraid ,

21.english_reference: and fled , and went into Egypt

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּבְרַ֖ח וַ יָּבֹ֥א מִצְרָֽיִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς Αἴγυπτον .
traditions.VUL: fugítque et ingréssus est Ægýptum .
traditions.KJV: and fled , and went into Egypt ;

22.english_reference: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁלַ֞ח הַ מֶּ֧לֶךְ יְהוֹיָקִ֛ים אֲנָשִׁ֖ים מִצְרָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς ἄνδρας εἰς Αἴγυπτον ,
traditions.VUL: Et misit rex Ióakim viros in Ægýptum ,
traditions.KJV: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt , [

22.english_reference: namely , Elnathan the son of Achbor , and certain men with him into Egypt

traditions.WLC: אֵ֣ת אֶלְנָתָ֧ן בֶּן עַכְבּ֛וֹר וַ אֲנָשִׁ֥ים אִתּ֖ וֹ אֶל מִצְרָֽיִם
traditions.VUL: Elnathan fílium Achobor , et viros cum eo , in Ægýptum .
traditions.KJV: namely ] , Elnathan the son of Achbor , and [ certain ] men with him into Egypt .

23.english_reference: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt

traditions.WLC: וַ יּוֹצִ֨יאוּ אֶת אוּרִיָּ֜הוּ מִ מִּצְרַ֗יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξηγάγοσαν αὐτὸν ἐκεῖθεν
traditions.VUL: Et eduxérunt Uríam de Ægýpto ,
traditions.KJV: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt ,

23.english_reference: and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king

traditions.WLC: וַ יְבִאֻ֨ הוּ֙ אֶל הַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹיָקִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰσηγάγοσαν αὐτὸν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα ·
traditions.VUL: et adduxérunt eum ad regem Ióakim ,
traditions.KJV: and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king ;

23.english_reference: who slew him with the sword

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּכֵּ֖ הוּ בֶּ חָ֑רֶב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν ἐν μαχαίρᾳ ,
traditions.VUL: et percússit eum gládio :
traditions.KJV: who slew him with the sword ,

23.english_reference: and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶת נִבְלָת֔ וֹ אֶל קִבְרֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י הָ עָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔριψεν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ μνῆμα υἱῶν λαοῦ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et proiécit cadáver eius in sepúlcris vulgi ignóbilis .
traditions.KJV: and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people .

24.english_reference: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah

traditions.WLC: אַ֗ךְ יַ֚ד אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן שָׁפָ֔ן הָיְתָ֖ה אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ
traditions.LXX: πλὴν χεὶρ Ἀχεικὰμ υἱοῦ Σαφὰν ἦν μετὰ Ἰερεμίου
traditions.VUL: Igitur manus Ahicam fílii Saphan fuit cum Ieremía ,
traditions.KJV: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah ,

24.english_reference: that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death

traditions.WLC: לְ בִלְתִּ֛י תֵּת אֹת֥ וֹ בְ יַד הָ עָ֖ם לַ הֲמִיתֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: τοῦ μὴ παραδοῦναι αὐτὸν εἰς χεῖρας τοῦ λαοῦ , μὴ ἀνελεῖν αὐτόν .
traditions.VUL: ut non traderétur in manus pópuli , et interfícerent eum .
traditions.KJV: that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death .
